title: Playing after the funeral and changing attitudes about funeral music
summary: Rene recalls bands playing lively ramble numbers after burial, and says people are now cautious about offending families.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line
